svg.title: Step-RL training pipeline
svg.desc: A five-stage loop showing environment exploration, trajectory collection, progress estimation, stepwise reward construction, and PPO policy updates, with editable milestone cards explaining dense credit assignment.

g.text: Step-RL: From Sparse Outcomes to Stepwise Rewards
A clearer credit-assignment loop for long-horizon language-agent training
Compare neighboring trajectory states—the increase in completion becomes an immediate learning signal
progress reward = λ(cₜ − cₜ₋₁), then combine it with grounding quality gₜ
Keep estimator training separate from reward inference
